mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Payroll growth historically correlates with equity market performance
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 135,000 thousand persons, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Federal Reserve's monetary policy transmission mechanism
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic expansion, strengthening corporate revenue visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Co-movement of labor and housing markets precedes equity gains
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both PAYEMS and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising >0.2pp in 3 months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary policy transmission to industrial output
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.2pp in 3 months and INDPRO declines >0.5% in the last month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 signals economic contraction, reducing corporate production capacity and earnings visibility, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 98, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Retail and housing co-movement predicts equity performance
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy, lowering risk-free rates and increasing equity attractiveness, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary policy impact on equity valuation
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
